title: French Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful French-inspired beef stew, perfect for a chilly evening. This recipe combines tender beef, fresh vegetables, and rich flavors of Worcestershire sauce.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion, sliced carrot, and chopped celery to the pot. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the Worcestershire sauce, flour, beef broth, red wine (if using), thyme, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the browned beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the beef is tender, about 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
